highlights: Adding several photos to a planting now shows the whole batch. The picker's photo strip was sized for a card footer, so in the planting fly-up it hid 7 of 10 photos behind an inner scrollbar and sliced the labels on the second row.

Tapping the number on the Untagged chip now works while a project or zone filter is on. The number counts your whole library, but the tagging deck was being built from the filtered view, so the tap did nothing at all.
"Clear", which discards a whole staged batch, is now a full-size tap target instead of a sliver.
